title: The Clay Hole Monthly Membership with Raku Certification
source_quote: Raku Workshop Certification. Fire. Tongs. Glowing pots.
evidence_sentence: Members can access raku workshops after completing required safety certification.
evidence_quote: Raku Workshop Safety. Required before any raku workshop. Fire, tongs, and pots pulled glowing from the kiln.
summary: Monthly membership ($145–$275/month) provides access to raku workshops after certification. Members also use the studio's electric glaze kiln for cone 6 work.
